title: Pixel-art water surface with wave glyphs and caustics
purpose: Generate a tileable pixel-art water tile at a chosen art resolution: dithered depth shades, evenly spread wave glyphs, sparkles, an optional caustic light network and foam clusters, with per-pixel normal, height, low roughness and occlusion maps. Use for seas, lagoons, swamps and rivers in 2D games.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python pixel_water_surface.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: art_pixels
parameters.meaning: Art pixels along each side of the tile; the maps enlarge them with nearest-neighbour sampling.

parameters.name: waves
parameters.meaning: Share of the evenly spread wave positions that get a wave glyph.

parameters.name: wave_length
parameters.meaning: Length of the light dash of a wave glyph in art pixels.

parameters.name: caustics
parameters.meaning: Coverage of the caustic light network of shallow water.

parameters.name: depth_patches
parameters.meaning: Contrast of the deep and shallow patches.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: Strength of the per-pixel normal map.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Open sea blue with white wave glyphs and sparkles.

presets.name: shallow_lagoon
presets.description: Clear turquoise shallows with a caustic light network.

presets.name: swamp
presets.description: Still murky green water with a few ripples and scum.

presets.name: rapids
presets.description: Rough grey-blue river water with long waves and foam.

limits: A still frame of stylized pixel art, not a wave simulation, and it does not animate; for motion, scroll the tile or swap seeds. The light from the top left is baked into the wave glyph colours. Caustics are a Voronoi line pattern, not traced light. Roughness and height are values per drawn class, and the normal map treats each art pixel as a flat facet. Output sizes that are not a whole multiple of art_pixels give art pixels of unequal widths. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate posterized to eighths.
technique_references: Poisson-disc sampling on a torus for glyph placement
Ordered dithering with a 4 x 4 Bayer matrix
Voronoi border lines as a caustic network
Thresholded fractal noise for foam clusters
